draws.stopping_rule: draw in order until 1 real-SAT and 0 real-UNSAT are kept; SAT = at least one real signed multiset of size 8 sums to R

enumeration.definition: real decomposition = signed multiset of m real base points with sum exactly R; algebraic = signed multisets over the 2B lifts of V to E(F_{p^2}) whose sum has abscissa x_R; algebraic_count = distinct unsigned multisets of V among them (gen.py decomposable); ordered_algebraic_solutions = sequences with no identity prefix (formula: targets.rs enumerate_alg)

label_leak_note: label (sat/unsat/planted) and the real/algebraic counts are classifier metadata needed for the panel's stratification; they are NOT inputs to a solver. a, b are the attacker's own multipliers of R = aP + bQ (needed to form relation rows), k is hidden.

tool.git_note: null when run outside a git checkout and PKM_M8_GIT_COMMIT was not set at build
tool.name: pkm_m8_panel
